operation.label: A Map’s polygon layers, collected for drawing

fixture.declaredRule: Extent is the sum over every ring of a polygon -- outer and interior alike -- of the absolute shoelace area of that ring, in square degrees. Holes are added, not subtracted.

criterion: the order of identifiers exactly as the declared extent rule gives it, the same multiset of identifiers in and out, and the layer, polygon and banded-polygon counts exact
notEstablished: That largest-first is the right draw order, or that a reader will not mistake the extent for a measurement of ground. It is unprojected and counts holes positively, so it is a sort key only.
